reviews.comment: Holy Chat GPT. Hanks uses Chat for everything, and encourages his students to use it. Along with that his rubrics are either simple or missing. I don't think I learned anything from him during this class. I learned a lot about machine learning, but all on my own. Very minimal useful feedback. Be prepared to figure it out on your own! Grades easily.

I don't think he taught anything meaningful after the first few weeks of class and often just rambled about random topics that did not relate to the course. For projects, he gave a bare-bones rubric, then graded us completely differently. The class is very project heavy so just make sure you do good on those.
Dr. Hanks did a great job teaching this course and equipping his students with the materials needed to succeed. It's obvious that he enjoys what he does and wants to see his students succeed.

Prof Hanks taught me to code way better than ENGR 102 ever did. He's really good at explaining the coding concepts. His feedback is usually vague and if you need help on an assignment he'll usually try to guide you in the right direction but it's not always super helpful. Exams are hard but not impossible. He is very reasonable with the workload.

Professor Hanks is amazing teacher. The class will challenge you however Professor Hanks provides with so many resources which helps you to succeed and grow as a coder. If you do all the assignments, then you will be very successful in this course.

Professor Hanks is awesome! He is very clear with his instructions, but he also expects a lot out of you. He answers questions quickly and well. The projects are daunting but he is a pretty understanding grader. I would make sure you have friends in the class to help out, but overall, he is very helpful!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things
